summary: Verified the PagedGrid click/drag bug fix on Home '熱門分類' and ran regressions for quick order, hot products, header search, and the 4 required backend endpoints. All targeted tests pass.

test_results.backend_pytest: 5/5 passed (payment-logos, settings, products/home, products/suggest, product detail for 7814/9440/15507)
test_results.cat_product_click_page1: PASS - cat-product-7814 in cat-paged-livestream navigates to /product/7814 and product-detail renders
test_results.cat_product_click_grid2: PASS - cat-product-14400 in cat-paged-games navigates correctly
test_results.cat_product_click_page2_via_dot: PASS - after clicking dot-1 on cat-paged-livestream, clicking page-2 icon (cat-product-7744) navigates to /product/7744
test_results.drag_regression: PASS - 300px horizontal mouse drag scrolls grid to page 2 (dot-1 becomes active, bg-orange-500) and URL does NOT change (no navigation)
test_results.quick_order_regression: PASS - quick-order-7814 navigates to product page
test_results.hot_product_regression: PASS - product-card-7814 navigates to product page
test_results.search_suggestions_regression: PASS - typing '抖音' in search-input returns 6 suggestions; clicking search-suggestion-7814 navigates to /product/7814

critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx PagedGrid uses pointer events without setPointerCapture and an 8px drag threshold; onClickCapture prevents navigation when drag.moved is true — fix is clean and effective.

Minor: 18 elements match '[data-testid^=cat-paged-]' because dot buttons use '{testid}-dot-{i}' pattern; not a bug but makes testid-prefix queries ambiguous — consider renaming dots to e.g. 'cat-dot-...' for cleaner selectors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression test at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers payment-logos, settings, products/home, products/suggest, and product-detail by id. Frontend PagedGrid bug is confirmed fixed; drag threshold = 8px; drag.moved blocks click via onClickCapture.
